title: Windows merge tests read git's forward-slash paths
why: Main's push run stays red until the Windows merge tests compare paths the way git prints them.
note: Finding, Oct 26 (build advisor 2): main's push run 40325058256 on b1e5a6d is red. All 5 gates-windows-merge shards failed in "Merge tool git-half fixture suite". merge/test_merge.py compares a native path (C:\Users\...\wt-feat) with git worktree list output, which uses forward slashes (C:/Users/.../wt-feat); the worktree exists. Failing: CutBranchTree.test_clean_merged_tree_is_removed_when_merged_is_the_pr_head, test_tree_whose_cwd_is_inside_it_is_kept, CutLanes.test_a_local_lane_*. These tests never finished on Windows before c61, as the jobs hit their caps. Fix, one cloud lane: normalize paths on both sides of each compare, and check whether merge.py's own worktree matching has the same flaw on Windows (if so, a real defect: fix it there, red then green); needs no answer from you. Placed ahead of c44 (triage, Oct 26): it is the last thing between main and a green push run, c61's goal.
